protocol.path: Three dimensions x two dtypes x affine on/off x normal/high offset. Original, bit-identical clone, three independent scalar arithmetic overrides, and all three together. SHA-matched per launch. Setting the active variance result to zero makes native rstd = 1/sqrt(0.001).
protocol.taps: 512x1024, input offset 1000, no affine, seed 61. On private copies of the same vendor image, return the operands and result of the active variance subtraction via the FP32 rstd output. Validate second_moment - mean_square and mean * mean bitwise over all rows.
protocol.candidates: v25 captured FX graph, compile_candidate for the proposed cluster and inductor plans, actual xpu_launch_async descriptor after warmup, 512x1024. Tolerances atol=rtol=0.0003 (float32) / 0.003 (float16). CPU FP64 reference takes the already rounded Add output.
protocol.prior: The 12 formal route traces and timing are from the v25 slow30 run. The tutorial binaries and statistic substitutions are from the v25 official A/B run.
